title: Wendell and the Alibi Anew
author: Jude Reyes
blurb: Astrid Brightwater, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
